name: Time's Tear
source:
Kazuhiko and his brother Hideo are orphans living under the supervision of their caretaker. Then, one night, Kazuhiko has a dream. Will it help him pass a test in school?

[From [url=https://renai.us/game/timestear]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
